data.title: 黄泉 · 河岸歇脚
data.description: 黄泉将刀放在身旁的草地上，坐在河岸看水流绕过石头。风吹动她的外套，她没有急着起身。
data.promptProse: Acheron sits unhurriedly on the grassy bank of a quiet river at dusk, her long sheathed blade resting flat in the grass beside her hip. She looks out across the stream as clear water curls around smooth dark stones while an evening breeze lifts the hem of her dark violet coat. Gentle sunset light reflects softly off the ripples and traces her side profile against the quiet shore.
data.animaCaption: Sitting on the grassy riverbank with her sheathed sword laid flat beside her, Acheron watches the current curl around smooth stones. Evening light glints on the flowing water as a gentle breeze stirs her dark coat.
